title: WebFiverr
tagline: Empowering content creators and consumers through blockchain technology and connecting the world's best minds to crowdsource the future of content
description: WebFiverr would be a platform that leverages the power of blockchain technology to enable proposers to post their needs and users to collaborate and create content together on their needs. This could include anything from writing and editing articles, to designing graphics and videos, to developing software and other digital products. Furthermore, the community will be incentivised to vote on different content posted and the amount can be then distributed among contributors
how_its_made:
,We ran into quite a few problems while building out the project :
1. We had some difficulty integrating Biconomy SDK with our smart contract because they install a lot of scripts (ideally a single script that combines all of the script would be much better)
2. We decided to use Push Protocol to send push notifications. This required us to deploy a subgraph on The Graph, and then connect it to Push Protocol. From our end, it's working perfectly but Push Protocol said they have a bug which is why notifications aren't getting sent from The Graph.
